title: Bonneville Bobber
description: The Triumph Bonneville Bobber delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort for riders demanding purposeful real-world performance. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a balanced Upright Neutral layout, it maintains ergonomic composure across extended highway and city riding.
